title: Posterior-Averaged Bellman Flow Matching for Distributional Critics
abstract: arXiv:2610.17788v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Distributional critics model the full return distribution, providing richer signals for exploration and risk-sensitive control. Recent work has shown that flow-based critics can model these distributions flexibly and provide effective supervision across flow time for temporal-difference learning. However, unlike standard flow matching with fixed data endpoints, a flow critic is trained on Bellman targets recursively generated by a learned target critic under the current policy. Existing objectives therefore either use noisy single-endpoint supervision or rely on the learned flow itself for additional guidance. Our key observation is that an intermediate bridge state may be compatible with several Bellman endpoints, so its velocity should average their directions under the corresponding posterior. translated_title: 用于分布评论家的后验平均贝尔曼流匹配
translated_abstract: 分布评论家对完整的回报分布进行建模，为探索和风险敏感控制提供更丰富的信号。最近的研究表明，基于流的评论家可以灵活地建模这些分布，并在整个流时间范围内为时序差分学习提供有效的监督。然而，与使用固定数据端点的标准流匹配不同，流评论家是在由当前策略下学习到的目标评论家递归生成的贝尔曼目标上进行训练的。因此，现有的训练目标要么使用噪声较大的单端点监督，要么依赖学习到的流本身来提供额外指导。我们的关键观察是，一个中间桥接状态可能与多个贝尔曼端点相容，因此其速度应当在相应后验下对这些端点的方向进行平均。我们提出了后验平均贝尔曼流匹配，该方法采样一个端点池，推断潜变量上的闭式后验……
tldr: 提出后验平均贝尔曼流匹配（PA-BFM），通过采样端点池并按闭式后验对多个贝尔曼端点的速度方向进行平均，从而改进分布流评论家的训练。
en_tdlr: Proposes Posterior-Averaged Bellman Flow Matching (PA-BFM), which samples a pool of endpoints and averages velocity directions over multiple Bellman endpoints under a closed-form posterior, improving the training of distributional flow critics.
